meta.title: To be en
meta.goal: Expresa estados, situaciones y ubicaciones pasadas utilizando was y were de forma precisa.

cards.title: To be en: qué expresa
cards.lede: Expresa estados, situaciones y ubicaciones pasadas utilizando was y were de forma precisa.

rows.value: I / he / she / it was tired yesterday · Estaba / era
you / we / they were at home last night · Estabas / éramos / estaban
Describe cómo eran o dónde estaban las personas o cosas en el pasado

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: Sujeto + was/were + Complemento · She was in London in 2022.
Sujeto + wasn't/weren't + Complemento · They weren't hungry after lunch.
Was/Were + Sujeto + Complemento? · Were you happy with the results?

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: It was very sunny during our weekend trip to the beach.
I was nervous before the interview, but my team was calm.
Where were you at 8 o'clock yesterday evening?
The concert wasn't expensive, so it was completely crowded.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: was (Singular: I, he, she, it)
columns.rule: Acompaña a la primera y tercera persona del singular
examples: He was my English teacher last year.

columns.label: were (Plural y You: you, we, they)
columns.rule: Acompaña a la segunda persona y a todos los sujetos plurales
examples: We were late for the train.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: They was happy at the party.
They were happy at the party.

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: I, he, she, it → was | you, we, they → were.
Usa wasn't / weren't sin añadir didn't.
Invierte el orden: Was/Were va antes del sujeto.
Was/were funciona como verbo principal (no necesita aux. did).

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: We ___ very busy at work all morning.
quiz.explain: El sujeto 'We' requiere 'were' para formar el pasado del verbo to be.

quiz.q: ___ she at the doctor's office this morning?
quiz.explain: Para el sujeto 'she' en pasado con to be se utiliza 'Was' al inicio de la pregunta.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál oración expresa correctamente una negación en pasado?
options: They weren't aware of the new schedule.
They didn't was aware of the new schedule.
They wasn't aware of the new schedule.
quiz.explain: 'They' requiere 'weren't' (were not). El auxiliar 'did' nunca se usa con 'was/were'.
